description: This file defines a class '_ENTERPRISE_BlockedUserList' responsible for managing and checking a blocked user list within a larger enterprise API system. It includes methods for initialization, verbose logging, and an async pre-call hook that enforces user blocking based on a list, cache, and database lookups.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_BlockedUserList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of blocked users, initializes from a list or file, and provides a hook method to enforce blocking during API calls.

methods.description: Logs verbose messages with optional level control and prints if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.description: Asynchronously enforces user blocking by checking against the blocked list, cache, and database, raising HTTP exceptions if block conditions are met.
